Five youths hit by train in Andhra Pradesh, four dead

In Andhra Pradesh's Srikakulam district, five youths were hit by the Rajya Rani Express while crossing a railway track. Four of the youths, identified as intermediate students, died in the incident. One youth sustained severe injuries and is in critical condition. The youths were reportedly fishing in floodwaters when the accident occurred.
